title: hebe × uniflora
intro: Hebe × uniflora, commonly known as the Hebe hybrid or 'Great Orme', is a flowering plant native to the Great Orme in Wales, and is a hybrid of Hebe subalpina and Hebe salicifolia. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, as well as its ability to aid in digestion and relieve symptoms of anxiety and stress. The therapeutic actions of Hebe × uniflora are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been shown to possess antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities. However, more research is needed to fully understand the effects and benefits of Hebe × uniflora, and it should be used under the guidance of a healthcare professional.
